I posted a reply in #coastal-team telling Bettina I can't set up the recurring Monday 08:00 digest. I wrote that before checking the scheduling tool's options in detail. The basis is that jobs scheduled from this session are local-only and can't post into Slack, so the digest would not go out on its own. I didn't create anything, and I didn't read either channel's content.

The offer in that reply stands: on Monday, anyone can ask me in #coastal-team and I'll post the digest from #coastal-team and #coastal-random. Someone with scheduling access to the workspace would need to set up the recurring post.
